periods.summary: Tatara is the Akatsuki member who behaves most like an actual underworld killer at the banquet. She openly admits that Tsukikage's information control makes exposure irrelevant, then tries to feed Shizuku chicken containing poisoned knife blades. Ikki senses her malice and knocks the plate away. She summons a chainsaw-like Device and wants to kill someone out of boredom, but Moroboshi, Kiriko, Kuraudo and other national-class fighters force her to back down. In the epilogue she accepts Stella's proposed four-on-one match.

key_events.summary: Poisons food for Shizuku and nearly starts a fight in the banquet hall.
Steps onto the field as one of Stella's four opponents.
